visualCharacteristics.purpose: Collapsible one-line toggles (related products, benefit details, featured resources, references, FAQs)
visualCharacteristics.description: Native details/summary toggles, closed by default, separated by thin rules; a small caret before a light 20-24px label rotates when open. Panels hold rich text (paragraphs, lists, CTA buttons); product items (image-file link + linked name + short text) render as a responsive grid of centred cards. Option open: every item starts expanded and the label is a 16px semibold question (FAQs).

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: title (plain text) | content (rich text). Product items in the content: a paragraph that only links to the image file (link text = alt), then the product name (heading or paragraph, usually linked), then an optional link-free description paragraph

usage.description: mybeckman.in resource pages: clinical-trials 'Related products', leukemia-and-lymphoma benefit toggles, synthetic-biology Featured Resources, protein-production 'View References' and FAQ (open).

reuseGuidance: Use for any title | content collapsible list, including FAQs (option open). Use tabs-underline or tabs-workflow when only one panel should be visible at a time.
